name: cardgame-design-shelf-server
title: Design Shelf LAN Server
pitch: Serve the already-generated design-shelf static site (tools/build-site.js output) over the local network so it's browsable from a phone.
why_now: T16's second named want — browsing world/races/characters/rules/cards without going to the computer — is only half-built: build-site.js generates site/ but nothing serves it off-machine; RouterBox still has to pick through files.
expected_outcome: Run `npm run site:serve`, then load http://<lan-ip>:<port>/ from a phone on the same wifi and see the design-shelf index (World/Races/Characters/Cards/Rules) render and navigate.
intent: Add a zero-dependency static file server that serves the design-shelf site (already produced by tools/build-site.js into site/) bound to 0.0.0.0 by default, exposed via an npm script, so the existing design content is reachable from a phone on the local network without any file/folder spelunking on the desktop.

criteria.text: tools/serve-site.js exists and starts a Node http server that serves files from the site/ directory
An npm script named site:serve runs tools/serve-site.js
The server binds host 0.0.0.0 by default (overridable) so it is reachable from other devices on the same LAN, not just localhost
GET / returns HTTP 200 and the design-shelf index.html body
Requests for a nonexistent path return HTTP 404 instead of crashing the server process
Served .html and .svg files include correct Content-Type response headers
